# wplbowling

Explore bowling performance in the Women’s Premier League (WPL).

Documentation website:
<https://etc5523-2026.github.io/etc5523-assignment-4-sjad0015-git/>

## Purpose

This package helps cricket coaches and analysts investigate which
bowlers perform most effectively across different phases of a T20
innings.

## Data

WPL bowling statistics derived from Cricsheet ball-by-ball data.

Source: <https://cricsheet.org/>

## Installation

``` r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github(
  "ETC5523-2026/etc5523-assignment-4-sjad0015-git",
  dependencies = TRUE
)
```

## Launch the app

``` r
library(wplbowling)
run_app()
```
